_comment: Recommended options for the launcher's 'Use recommended options' box. env names must start with KYTY_ or MVK_; env values and args are plain strings without % " ^ ! or control characters. Entries under titles are keyed by title ID and win over global. The dialog settings and variables already set in the environment win over both. Set KYTY_PRESETS to use a file of your own: this one is overwritten by builds and installs.
